title: Dot along line y = 2x
prerequisite: Learner can read a point (x, y) on a graph.
success_check: Learner predicts y for a new x on the line y = 2x before the dot moves there.

scenes.title: Dot along line, one cue
scenes.concept_target: On the line y = 2x, y grows twice as fast as x as the dot moves.

narration_cues.text: Watch the dot move along the line y equals two x. As x grows, y grows twice as fast.
narration_cues.change: The dot travels along the line from left to right while the y = 2x label stays visible.
